text: 泰国政府正考虑下调生物燃料消费税，压低价格并拉动消费。能源部发言人蓬波尔・约德孟查伦（Pongpol Yodmuangcharoen）在周三新闻发布会上表示，能源部与财政部正在拟定减税方案。蓬波尔称，生物燃料由汽油或柴油混合生物质燃料制成，可在本土低成本生产。生物汽油与生物柴油的消费税约为每升6泰铢。扩大生物燃料使用将有助于减少原油进口，减轻政府燃油补贴压力。
text_en: Thailand's government is considering cutting the excise tax on biofuels to lower prices and spur consumption. Energy Ministry spokesman Pongpol Yodmuangcharoen said at a Wednesday news conference that the Energy Ministry and Finance Ministry are drafting the tax-cut plan. Pongpol said biofuels are made by blending gasoline or diesel with biomass fuels and can be produced locally at low cost. The excise tax on biogasoline and biodiesel is about 6 baht per liter. Expanding biofuel use will help reduce crude oil imports and ease pressure on the government's fuel subsidies.
